texts.value: DAC_MCU — STM32H747 SMA RECEIVER / BIPOLAR CONVERTER
External MCU board: VDDA / VREF+ nominal 3.3 V; DAC1_OUT1 PA4 and DAC1_OUT2 PA5. No MCU is placed on this receiver.
High-impedance outputs, NOT 50-ohm terminated. VOUT = (100k/14k)*(VIN - VREF+/2); 0.25..3.05 V -> -10..+10 V.
CHANNEL A — INPUT DEFAULTS TO VBIAS; OUTPUT DEFAULTS TO GND
CHANNEL B — INPUT DEFAULTS TO VBIAS; OUTPUT DEFAULTS TO GND
MCU sequence: calibrate DAC buffers -> write midscale -> enable input relay -> wait signal/relay settling -> enable output relay.
Receiver buffer does NOT remove coax capacitance from MCU pin. Keep source CL <=50 pF or use a source-side cable-driver buffer.
12-bit MCU DAC: ~5.75 mV/output LSB; INL up to 4 LSB ~23 mV. Two-point calibration cannot remove INL.
Do not substitute a local 3.3 V source for the MCU VREF+ tracking input. Both enable controls must default low.
